title: Đầu tư phát triển nông nghiệp, nông thôn

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze economic factors in agricultural and rural development investments.
Manage and oversee agricultural and rural development projects effectively.
Conduct financial analysis for investment decisions in agricultural and rural development.
Analyze market conditions for agricultural and rural development investments.
Select appropriate technologies for agricultural and rural development projects.
Assess risks in agricultural and rural development investments.
Evaluate social, economic, and environmental impacts of agricultural and rural development investments.
Work independently and take personal responsibility for tasks.
Apply critical thinking to solve practical problems in agricultural and rural development.
Communicate effectively in group discussions and presentations.
Make ethical decisions in evaluating agricultural and rural development projects.
